scope: Phase 1 greybox traversal and collision; no Phase 2 art or NPC acceptance
inputMethod: Playwright keyboard and right-mouse drag. The main route never teleports or writes simulation state.
checks: Actual keyboard traversal: west spawn → six hill stair risers → hill plaza → south stair descent → Ring Gate pad → Lattice Jack pad; no teleports or fallthrough
Shop porch stair ascent/descent, doorway access, camera boom obstruction and recovery
1.8 m capsule traverses and stands inside the west gate tunnel
Full-speed sprint cannot tunnel through the city wall; diagonal input slides along it
Browser blur clears a held movement key
Escape pause/resume and R reset return to grounded spawn
A/D strafe, S reverse and arrow-key movement follow the camera axes
Six fixed 1080p camera captures queue correctly and restore player, active view, named camera projections, renderer size/DPR and draw counts
Survey UI selects a named camera, saves an actual frame, and returns to the player camera
Desktop, laptop and narrow viewport nonblank canvas and UI bounds; narrow-screen captures preserve fixed camera projection
Actual touch hold moves the capsule; release and pointer cancellation clear movement
limitations: Headless browser uses a software GPU. Its FPS is not the medium laptop GPU 60 fps acceptance result. Native browser evidence is required separately.

initial.scope: Phase 1 greybox city: capsule walking, gravity, stairs, porches, gate tunnels and camera collision. Concept art, authored world/characters, dialogue, shop and audio remain later phases.
